register.labelZh: BELIEVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: BELIEVE 表達可以幫助你談論鬼魂、魔法、外星人,以及其他可能真實或不真實的事物。；你可以用 believe in something 或 believe in doing something,表達自己認同哪些理念和做法。；believe something of somebody 可以幫助你表達某個關於別人的說法是否可信,或是否令人難以接受。
register.summaryEn: BELIEVE expressions help you discuss ghosts, magic, aliens and other things that may or may not be real. You can use believe in something or believe in doing something to show which ideas and actions you support. believe something of somebody helps you say whether a report about a person seems possible or is difficult to accept.
